newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures end higher,off highs.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures end higher,off highs.

text.p: June 9 - Most U.S. stock index futures ended moderately higher, off day and record-high peaks. Traders said afternoon trade was light, with June S&P 500s finding intraday support near 862.90-60 area. Bias still seen tilted to upside after recent rally, first obstacle pegged near 870.00. Nikkei fell on wire house sales, yen's bounce on U.S.-Japan trade jitters.
